questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Kei or Badgers?
At Centurion Park, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (List A)?
At Kimberley Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
At which ground did Imam Bonnasse record their career-best bowling figures (4-17, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at St George's Park, against Iinyathi on 2024/11/16.

questions.question: At which ground did Limpopo Lillies record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — highest total of 136, against Knights on 2025/11/02.

questions.question: Which South African provincial union has a team playing in the Women's Japan Premier League?
questions.explanation: A result of the partnership between Titans Cricket Union and Japan Cricket Association.
